script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: The passage records a command to be silent and listen, not the crowd becoming quiet and listening. It has also already instructed the people to cross the Jordan and build an altar, so saying nobody has been told to take a step yet is misleading.
The verse does not say the person is standing there, doing nothing at all, or rule out shoving or tripping. It says the cursed person lets a blind man wander in the road.
Moses instructs the people to say Amen after each curse; the passage does not say they actually answer at this point.
